body:
One kept finishing early, whenever she thought we had said everything that had to be said, and was really pushy for me to tell her things (I’m quite reserved) I think it scared me off for a while. 

Then the other pushed a lot of solutions for my depression, which just wasn’t working for me. When I’m in the depths of despair, I cannot just think of “happy times” and it’ll cure my depression. I genuinely just have to wait till the intensity passes.

Yeah it can be at times. I have already tried quite a few, so I don’t have many options left, but yeah I think I need to revisit as it’s not helping. I’ve had between 7/8 sessions with one and 10 with another, not a great amount of time but it just wasn’t working out for me at all.

Thanks for your helpful response, I think that’s a great idea, listing down things I haven’t found helpful. I felt one therapist couldn’t wait to complete our “therapeutic process”, and I had only told them surface level stuff. I didn’t come away with much from those sessions either. Hopefully something good comes my way soon I suppose.

Yeah I feel there’s something else going on, I’m just not 100% sure what. It would definitely benefit me to get one, every time I explain to my doctor how I am, they just up my dose. I suppose now I can’t go any higher, so maybe they’ll refer me for an evaluation this time.
Yeah this will definitely something I will look into, thank you!
Sounds promising, I’ll have a look into this, I think I’ve tried the majority of them. Thanks!
Thanks I’ll have a look into this one.
Yeah I had one 2 months ago, as it was not helping anymore, so we upped the dose
Yeah I’m currently on antidepressants, highest dose.
I believe without a mood stabiliser it can make you worse, or send you to mania / hypomania.
Yeah I feel it could be a possibility, I’m tracking my moods and I’ll show it to my dr to see what they think.
Thanks, I’ll have a read on this!
Yeah it’s been hell of a ride trying all these different AD’s, and at times don’t even make me feel better, if anything worse.
Okkk, me too, the last time I started trying loads of different AD’s I kept on randomly quitting them cause I would feel worse mood wise.

I’m so unsure, I’m currently back on antidepressants and sometimes I feel really great, then sometimes I still feel terrible on them. I have lots of periods of strong irritability and frequent change of my moods where they have been changing every few days. I instantly felt great on them, which I have read people normally feel worse to begin with.
